title: The Black Scorpion stalks Sting
summary: A masked enemy claims knowledge of Sting’s past and tries to undermine his championship reign. Multiple appearances and disguises lead to a final unmasking at Starrcade.

chapters.title: Sting beats a Scorpion, but the mystery remains
chapters.result: Sting defeats the Black Scorpion in a title defense.
chapters.context: The victory does not reveal the ultimate antagonist behind the continuing mind games.

chapters.title: Flair is revealed under the mask
chapters.result: Sting defeats and unmasks the final Black Scorpion as Ric Flair.
chapters.context: The cage-match reveal connects the mystery back to Sting’s established rival. Earlier Scorpion appearances involved other performers.
